title: The Football Final
description: Four recordings about a school football final: a chat, a stadium announcement, half-time advice and a radio report.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Before the match
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and Ben talking about the football final.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Ben, are you excited about the football final on Saturday?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Very! Our school plays against Park School. I'm playing in defence this time.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Really? I thought you always played in goal.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I did, but Tim hurt his arm, so the coach asked me to change. Actually, I prefer defence.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My brother's coming to watch. He's bringing a big blue flag.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Our colour is red! But that's fine. Will you come by bus?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: No, my dad is going to drive us. We'll arrive early to get good seats.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Good idea. I'm so nervous, I can't eat breakfast on match days. I only drink a glass of milk.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Don't worry, Ben. You always play well. I'm sure your team will win.

parts.title: Part 2 · At the stadium
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement before the Schools Cup final.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the Schools Cup final. The match starts at three o'clock, not half past two as it says on some tickets.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: The car park is full, so please leave your cars in the field behind the school.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: You can buy drinks and ice creams near gate four. Please put your rubbish in the bins.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: If you find a lost bag, please give it to the lady in the school office.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: After the match, the head teacher will give the cup to the winning team. Now, please stand up and welcome the players!

parts.title: Part 3 · At half-time
parts.intro: You will hear a coach, Lan, talking to a player, Minh, at half-time.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Minh, you ran very well in the first half, but we're losing one-nil.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I know, Coach. I'm tired, and my feet hurt a bit.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Drink some water. In the second half, pass the ball to Nam. He's fast and he's free on the left.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: OK. Shall I try to score myself?

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Only if you're near the goal. Don't shoot from far away. That's what you did in the first half.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: You're right. I was a little nervous.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Don't worry. Be brave and enjoy the game. We can still win.

parts.title: Part 4 · Radio sports news
parts.intro: You will hear a radio report about the football final.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: And now the sports news. Last night's final was very exciting. Park School scored first, but Green Hill School won three-two in the last minute.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The winning goal was scored by a girl called Hana, who is only eleven years old. Her team-mates carried her on their shoulders.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The captain, Minh, said, we never stopped believing. More than two hundred people watched the match, and the sun shone all afternoon.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The winners will visit the zoo next week. It's a surprise from their head teacher.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The players from Park School were sad, but they clapped for the winners. That was a lovely thing to see. Well done to both teams!
